title: How luxury beauty is taking off in travel retail
summary: Beauty’s premium players such as L’Oréal and Estée Lauder Companies have been increasingly benefiting from travel retail, as the humble airport creates a shift in consumer shopping habits that is allowing luxury beauty to thrive

extraction.key_fact: 프리미엄 뷰티 기업들이 공항 면세 유통에서 점점 더 큰 이익을 얻고 있다.
